basics.name: Wilson Espina
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Frontend Engineer with 8+ years building data-driven React and TypeScript applications, including 4+ years delivering Connected TV experiences at ITV for large-screen and web platforms. I lead technical solutions end-to-end, from architecture to delivery, with a strong focus on performance on constrained devices, maintainable code, and reliable releases. I collaborate closely with product, design, QA, and backend teams, provide clear technical guidance to stakeholders, and mentor engineers to raise team capability.

experienceAreas.name: Project Work
points: Owned and delivered React TypeScript features for New Zealand's National Ticketing Solution, integrating UI components with a backend-for-frontend (BFF) layer to create data-driven user experiences with high accessibility standards.
Collaborated daily with product stakeholders, UX/UI designers, QA, and backend engineers, iterating on Figma designs and clarifying requirements early to structure delivery efficiently.
Built clean, reusable and accessible React components to consume headless Contentful CMS content, streamlining content operations and improving maintainability.
Implemented Auth0 integration for secure user sign-up and access control, delivering robust production-ready solutions with minimal oversight.

experienceAreas.name: Delivering to deadlines
points: Quickly adapted to new technologies while working with New Zealand’s largest company, Fonterra, delivering interactive frontend solutions within tight delivery timelines.
Favouring practical solutions, improved team productivity by introducing faster Vite-based workflows and pragmatic UI implementation patterns.

experienceAreas.name: Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
points: Led front-end implementations of A/B experiments to optimise user journeys, improve conversion, and contribute directly to revenue outcomes.
Implemented bespoke Optimizely experimentation solutions and drove technical collaboration across QA, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver robust releases.

experienceAreas.name: Process Improvement
points: Drove improvements in team efficiency by refining Agile ceremonies, automating manual workflows, and improving delivery processes through continuous feedback.

experienceAreas.name: Project Work
points: Owned end-to-end frontend delivery for Kiwibank, a major New Zealand retail bank, building scalable, maintainable React TypeScript components and proactively collaborating with backend engineers, UX/UI designers, and business analysts to align technical solutions with business requirements.

Delivered robust technical solutions within strict time and budget constraints for social justice sector clients, proactively managing competing priorities and maintaining quality standards throughout.
Advocated for the latest CSS best practices and tooling within projects, resulting in reduced bundled sizes and increased maintainability.
Led the frontend development for a Wagtail CMS-driven blog for the Kiwibank website, integrating Elastic Search UI React components and maintaining accessibility best practices.

experienceAreas.name: ITVX Streaming Platform
points: Led technical delivery of complex Connected TV features for ITV Hub/ITVX across web and Samsung CTV platforms, building responsive, fluid, data-driven user experiences at broadcast scale.
Pioneered adoption of an internal GraphQL API by optimising queries and dynamic layout composition, improving data flow and rendering performance for large-screen interfaces.
Coordinated engineers to deliver React TypeScript components across CTV and web applications, shaping technical direction, reviewing architecture decisions, and mentoring junior developers.
Developed clean, type-safe components within an Atomic Design System, improving maintainability, reliability, and consistency across multiple device experiences.

experienceAreas.name: Mentoring
points: Facilitated and delivered technical GraphQL workshops for frontend engineers, helping teams adopt new patterns and improve engineering quality.
Provided in-depth mentorship through pairing, code reviews, and technical guidance, supporting engineers to improve their craft and increase delivery impact.

experienceAreas.name: General Skills
points: Championed a shift-left testing approach using Cypress and React Testing Library, improving release confidence, debugging efficiency, and feedback speed.
Optimised DOM rendering in a CTV application, resolving performance bottlenecks on low-powered devices and improving living-room user experience.
Implemented subtitle integration for Samsung CTV devices on ITV Hub, improving accessibility and playback experience for large-screen audiences.
Built new ITV Hub CTV features in vanilla JavaScript using object-oriented patterns, delivering reliable interactivity on constrained smart TV environments.

points: Modernised the JavaScript remote course by incorporating current industry best practices and the latest tools, resulting in an enhanced learning experience for students.
Created and delivered engaging lessons, guided exercises, and focused homework, teaching the fundamentals of the JavaScript language to students and facilitating their skill development.

experienceAreas.name: Mentoring
points: Provided personalised support and one-on-one tuition to students working on personal projects, guiding them through development challenges and facilitating their growth as developers.

experienceAreas.name: General Skills

Collaborated with the UX/UI team to realise customer journeys through the company's AngularJS web application, ensuring a cohesive and intuitive user experience.

experienceAreas.name: Learning
points: Completed an intensive web development and agile project techniques bootcamp at General Assembly London in 2017, where I learned the fundamentals of frontend engineering through structured learning and pair programming exercises.

experienceAreas.name: Project Work
points: Demonstrated knowledge and expertise in frontend technologies by building personal projects during the bootcamp.
Created an interactive maze game using jQuery, which incorporated HTML Audio Elements triggered by user events.
Completed an individual project that utilised React, Node, and Express to connect to the Strava and Google Maps APIs, resulting in a Strava run patterns application.
